First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

builds.name: Spirit Fire: AP impact plus full burn
builds.summary: Investigate high Spirit Fire impact and five-second exposure output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Spirit Fire impact and five-second exposure output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E has 170 + 0.6 AP initial magic damage and five seconds at 34 + 0.12 AP per second: nominal total 340 + 1.2 AP with uninterrupted exposure. E's armor reduction helps later physical damage, not its own magic packets. Earned Seraph/Deathcap feed AP; conditional magic amplifiers must be recorded at each tick.

ceiling.targetName: Spirit Fire impact and five-second exposure
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Record actual AD/AP and resists; stop observed scoring when a target dies and report raw overkill separately. One E, one full-health champion in the zone for five seconds. No Q, R or physical attack. Seraph legally transformed; Riftmaker pre-ramped independently. No repeated E refresh used to extend the window. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 5s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Prior champion combat 4s does not automatically grant arbitrary item stacks.
